import sys,json,importlib.util,traceback,time
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import torch
BASE=Path('/workspace/upstream/service-world-reference');torch.set_num_threads(1);rows=[]
for name in ['coupled_wireless_model','tdmpc2_world_model']:
 row={'name':name,'scope':'Untrained CPU shape/import smoke; not a task reproduction or performance benchmark'}
 try:
  if name=='coupled_wireless_model':
   path=BASE/'coupled_robot_wireless/c_jepa/wireless_jepa/src/utils/models.py';spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('official_wireless_models',path);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
   encoder=m.Encoder().eval();predictor=m.Predictor(4,32,1,2).eval();power=m.PowerPredictor().eval()
   with torch.no_grad():
    csi=torch.complex(torch.randn(2,384),torch.randn(2,384));z=encoder(csi);forecast,h=predictor(torch.randn(2,6,4));p=power(z)
   row.update(passed=True,shapes={'CSI_encoder':list(z.shape),'latent_predictor':list(forecast.shape),'power_head':list(p.shape)},finite=bool(torch.isfinite(p).all()),source=str(path))
  else:
   sys.path.insert(0,str(BASE/'tdmpc2-python-deps'));sys.path.insert(0,str(BASE/'tdmpc2/tdmpc2'))
   from common.world_model import WorldModel
   cfg=SimpleNamespace(multitask=False,task_dim=0,latent_dim=32,action_dim=2,mlp_dim=64,num_bins=11,vmin=-10.,vmax=10.,bin_size=2.,episodic=False,num_q=2,dropout=.01,log_std_min=-10,log_std_max=2,simnorm_dim=8,obs_shape={'state':(16,)},obs='state',num_enc_layers=2,enc_dim=64,tau=.01)
   model=WorldModel(cfg).eval()
   with torch.no_grad():
    z=model.encode(torch.randn(2,16),None);a=torch.zeros(2,2);zn=model.next(z,a,None);r=model.reward(z,a,None);q=model.Q(z,a,None,return_type='avg')
   row.update(passed=True,shapes={'encoded':list(z.shape),'next':list(zn.shape),'reward':list(r.shape),'Q':list(q.shape)},finite=bool(torch.isfinite(q).all()),source=str(BASE/'tdmpc2/tdmpc2/common/world_model.py'))
 except Exception as e:row.update(passed=False,error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 rows.append(row)
(BASE/'torch_smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps({'torch':torch.__version__,'cuda':torch.cuda.is_available(),'results':rows},indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))

reproduction_harnesses.name: smoke_dreamer.py
reproduction_harnesses.original_audit_harness_source:
import sys,json,traceback
from pathlib import Path
BASE=Path('/workspace/upstream/service-world-reference');sys.path.insert(0,str(BASE/'dreamerv3'))
r={'scope':'Official untrained DreamerV3 RSSM CPU shape smoke; no warehouse task adaptation or score'}
try:
 import jax,jax.numpy as jnp,numpy as np,ninjax as nj,elements
 from dreamerv3.rssm import RSSM
 model=RSSM({'action':elements.Space(np.float32,(2,))},deter=32,hidden=32,stoch=4,classes=4,blocks=4,name='smoke_rssm')
 def forward():
  c=model.initial(2)
  c,entries,feat=model.observe(c,jnp.zeros((2,3,8)),{'action':jnp.zeros((2,3,2))},jnp.zeros((2,3),bool),False)
  c,pred,actions=model.imagine(c,{'action':jnp.zeros((2,3,2))},3,False)
  return c,entries,pred
 params,out=nj.pure(forward)({},seed=42,create=True)
 r.update(passed=True,jax=jax.__version__,devices=[str(d) for d in jax.devices()],shapes=jax.tree.map(lambda a:list(a.shape),out),finite=bool(all(np.isfinite(np.asarray(a)).all() for a in jax.tree.leaves(out))),parameter_arrays=len(params))
except Exception as e:r.update(passed=False,error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
(BASE/'dreamer_forward_smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
